subject: Renewal horizon: portfolio health flags + proposed collection cadence
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal horizon: portfolio health flags + proposed collection cadence

Team —

I ran the mid-month renewal hygiene sweep and flagged a small cohort of accounts where our forecast will need an explicit collection cadence and either a short-term concession or escalation to CS. Top-of-list: Acme Analytics (ACME-2024-RNW-42) — current ARR $420k, scheduled renewal 2026-11-22. Why flagged: late usage spike + open support ticket impacting ingest pipeline (ticket 4210) and procurement delay on PO.

Goal for this thread: align on next outreach steps, proposed cadence for collection/follow-up, and whether we recommend a targeted discount or credit to preserve ARR. I suggest the following starting plan: 
- Week 0 (today): Account exec outreach + prep call with Success (internal)
- Week 1: Escalation email to procurement + Docusign SOW re-share
- Week 2: If no PO, 2nd escalation and prepare billing hold options (legal ops to advise)

Questions for Rafael and Sergio:
1) Rafael — can you confirm whether procurement has been engaged by the AE and if there's any legal redline traction?
2) Sergio — support context on ticket 4210 — is this likely to be resolved before renewal? Impact on account sentiment?

I attached the latest SOW draft (Acme_Renewal_SOW_v3.pdf) and the support ticket export stub. Please reply with short bullets — we want to pull an updated commit into the forecast by COB Monday.

Thanks,
Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Sr. Renewals Manager | Redwood Inference
:jasmine.liu@redwood.com

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal horizon: portfolio health flags + proposed collection cadence

Jasmine —

Short answers/bullets: 
- Procurement touch: AE did an initial intro two weeks ago; procurement responded asking for updated SOW and formal quote (we didn't re-send after last product-change note). I pinged AE to prioritize.
- Legal redlines: none significant yet; their preferred clause was a shorter payment term which we can accommodate with a 1% discount for 30 days net.
- Proposed cadence tweak: Move the Docusign re-share to today (I will do it) and follow up with procurement on Tuesday morning.

I'm attaching the SOW with two inline comments where price and payment term are negotiable. If we want to preserve full ARR, I recommend offering a one-time onboarding credit (2.5% of ARR) tied to ticket closure and a 30-day payment term. That keeps list price but gives them liquidity.

Attachments: Acme_Renewal_SOW_v3.pdf (commented)

—Rafael
Rafael Mendes | Account Director, Mid-Market

From: Jordan Park <success@acme-analytics.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-analytics.com
Date: 2026-10-18T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal horizon: portfolio health flags + proposed collection cadence

Hi Jasmine / team —

Thanks for the outreach. A few quick things from our side: 
- Support ticket 4210 is impacting our ETL into the model store; our engineers are blocked on re-ingest. We really need that resolved this week to sign off on renewal internally.
- Procurement is also asking for a clearer breakdown of professional services vs. platform seats in the SOW before we can route PO.
- Pricing pressure is real — our CFO is pushing back on any increase. If there is a small, one-off credit tied to ticket closure, that will help move this forward.

Can we schedule a 30-minute sync with product/support and procurement tomorrow morning (Oct 19) to align on scope and paperwork? Rafael — if you can re-send the SOW today that would be helpful.

Best,
Jordan Park
Head of Customer Success, Acme Analytics

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Park <success@acme-analytics.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T15:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal horizon: portfolio health flags + proposed collection cadence

Jordan — appreciate the context. Quick technical note: ticket 4210 root cause is a recent change in our ingestion schema that increased strictness on timestamp parsing; we have a fix on staging and a targeted patch for production scheduled tonight. ETA: full mitigation within 36 hours assuming no regressions.

Operational ask to Acme: can you provide one failing ingest payload example to speed verification? That will let us confirm the patch resolves your case before the renewal call.

From a risk perspective: given the timing, I support Rafael's proposal — limited onboarding credit (2.5% ARR) conditional on ticket closure and a 30-day net payment term. That should keep legal/procurement happy and avoids a larger price concession.

Attached: support-ticket-4210.pdf (export)

I'll join the sync tomorrow and bring the engineering lead.

—Sergio
Sergio Alvarez | Director, Customer Reliability Engineering

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Park <success@acme-analytics.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, procurement@acme-analytics.com
Date: 2026-10-19T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal horizon: portfolio health flags + proposed collection cadence

Thanks all —

Recap and asks (for internal ops and forecast update):
- Agreed path: Rafael to re-send SOW today (done), Rafael to record contact and updated close plan in HubSpot by COB today. HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/123456
- Commercial concession: one-time onboarding credit = 2.5% ARR conditional on ticket closure, with 30-day net payment term. Rafael to confirm final numbers in the quote.
- Technical path: Sergio's patch ETA within 36 hours; Jordan to share failing payload sample to success@acme-analytics.com to accelerate verification.
- Follow-up cadence: AE outreach today, procurement follow-up Tue morning, renewal sync scheduled 2026-10-19 10:00 AM PT (calendar invite sent).

Forecast action: I will move Acme from "Commit - Green" to "Commit - Conditional" in the forecast and apply a 60% probability until we receive PO and ticket closure. Rafael — please update the expected close date to 2026-11-15 if procurement confirms expedited routing.

Closing note: please keep replies short; I will collect final bullets and push an updated commit list to finance Monday morning.

Thanks,
Jasmine
Sr. Renewals Manager | Redwood Inference
